scope: Gate-2 mapping: identify exactly what app/src/main/assets/wincomponents ships and where its license files are.
method: PE version resources (UTF-16) and import tables (llvm-objdump -p) read from the shipped DLLs; archive listings for license files.
discriminator: Wine builtin PE DLLs always import ntdll.dll (verified on the bundled Proton's d3d11.dll, msvcrt.dll, dsound.dll). Most wincomponents DLLs do not; and each carries Microsoft or third-party version-resource identity. Note some MS runtime DLLs also import ntdll for Rtl* routines, so ntdll alone is not decisive - the version resources are.

vcrun2010.evidence: msvcr100/atl100/msvcp100/vcomp100: CompanyName "Microsoft Corporation", FileDescription "Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime Library", FileVersion 10.00.40219.325; imports KERNEL32/MSVCR100, no ntdll

direct3d.identity: Microsoft legacy DirectX End-User Runtime (June 2010 / DXSDK_AUG09)
direct3d.evidence: d3dx9_43 FileVersion 9.29.952.3111 OriginalFilename D3DX9D.dll; xact/d3d "built by: DIRECTX", "DXSDK_AUG09.090904-1607"; CompanyName Microsoft Corporation; d3dx9/d3dcompiler/d3dcsx/d3dx10/d3dx11

directmusic.evidence: dmusic/dmsynth/dmband/dmime/dmloader/dmcompos/dmscript/dmstyle: CompanyName Microsoft Corporation, ProductName "MicrosoftR WindowsR Operating System", FileVersion 5.3.0000000.900 built by: DIRECTX

directsound.evidence: dsound.dll: CompanyName Microsoft Corporation, Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation

ddraw.evidence: ddraw.dll CompanyName "github.com/FunkyFr3sh", ProductName cnc-ddraw, FileDescription "DirectDraw replacement", FileVersion 6.6.0.0, LegalCopyright "Copyright (c) 2010-2024"; no ntdll import

license_bundle_gap.finding: The app's own licenses/ bundle covers only OpenSSL and curl. No wincomponents archive contains a license, copying or notice file.

related_archive_gaps.imagefs.tzst: 10892 files; usr/share/doc carries per-package licenses for only 5 packages (pcre2 COPYING, libjpeg-turbo LICENSE.md, lzo COPYING, tiff-4.7.0 LICENSE.md, zimg COPYING)

meaning: These are not Wine builtins. Redistribution of each is governed by its own rights holder terms, which differ per package: the VC++ 2010 Redistributable and the DirectX End-User Runtime ship under Microsoft redistribution terms with conditions; the DirectShow (quartz, Win7 SP1) and Windows Media (wmvcore, WMP 11) pieces are not part of those redistributable packages; cnc-ddraw is a third-party open-source project whose license file is not bundled. No legal conclusion is drawn here; each needs its own rights review and a bundled license file before public distribution.
next_steps: Record the exact source (upstream package/version) for each archive.
Bundle the license text each rights holder requires.
Decide per component: keep (with terms), replace (e.g. Wine's own implementations), or drop from the shipped product.
Same mapping for proton-9.0-arm64ec.txz and imagefs.tzst (source and license per package).
open: This closes the identification half of distribution blocker 2. Source mapping and license bundling remain open.

open_alternative_verified.action: set direct3d=0, dinput8=0, vcrun2010=0 in the container .container
open_alternative_verified.result: restoreWineBuiltinDllFiles copies Proton 11.0-2 Wine builtins back; session starts normally (13 processes)
open_alternative_verified.note: restoreOneWineDll deletes the target when no Wine builtin exists, so those three are lost when the component is switched off; games needing them still require the Microsoft payload.

runtime_behaviour.what_wine_supplies: The bundled Proton implements 46 of 49 direct3d modules, 10/10 directmusic, 6/6 directshow, 7/8 directplay, 35/43 xaudio, 1/1 directsound, 1/1 dinput8 and 4/4 vcrun2010 (confirmed by filename in lib/wine/aarch64-windows and ntdll imports; real sizes, not stubs).
